visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a medium shot of a woman with long reddish-brown hair wearing a white off-the-shoulder top and a black protective mask. She is seated in the driver's seat of a modern car, looking forward with her hands on the steering wheel, which features a prominent shield-shaped logo. The car's interior is dark with grey leather accents, and natural daylight enters through the windshield. (2) A full-screen graphic overlay appears, displaying a collage of health and beauty products, including pink boxes of jelly, sunglasses, and coupons. The background of this graphic is light blue with illustrations of crabs and lemons, suggesting a summer theme. (3) The scene returns to the car interior where the woman is driving and looking toward the passenger side. She gestures with her right hand while talking, her expression lively even behind the mask. Yellow and white variety-style captions appear at the bottom center. (4) An animated sequence is shown, featuring a cartoon illustration of a scientist at a laboratory station. The background is white, and text boxes explain a production process. Subsequent frames show a group of medical professionals and icons representing Japanese and French patent offices. (5) Back in the car, the woman continues to drive. Animated gold coins and dollar signs fall across the screen, accompanied by glowing star effects. She claps her hands together briefly while looking toward the camera. (6) The setting transitions to a large, brightly lit exhibition hall with high ceilings and industrial metal beams. Crowds of people are seen walking through wide aisles between colorful booths. A large sign reads 'BIO Asia-Taiwan'. (7) The woman is now standing inside the exhibition hall. She wears the same white top and carries a large black leather bag over her shoulder. She gestures toward various booths while looking directly at the camera. Graphic icons of Erlenmeyer flasks and dollar symbols ($1, $2, $6) appear next to her. (8) Close-up shots focus on product displays, showing boxes of 'Nutri-Crypt' fruit jelly. A scientific demonstration is shown where a yellow liquid is being poured into a large glass beaker with a thermometer attached. The lighting is bright and clinical. (9) The woman stands at a booth, engaged in conversation with a man wearing a white short-sleeved shirt and a tie. They are surrounded by product packaging and informative posters. She listens intently while looking at the displayed items on the green-carpeted floor. (10) The final sequence shows the woman walking through the hall, smiling and waving toward the camera. She brings her hands up to her face in a playful gesture. In the final seconds, a 'devil horn' graphic appears on her head as she looks playfully at the camera.

A series of metallic 'shimmer' sound effects are used as text bubbles appear on the master track. (3) A distinct 'whoosh' transition occurs as the scene shifts to an explanatory section. narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a personal vlog combined with a product development showcase. The creator starts by building anticipation about her 'second career' and then takes the audience on a journey to the BIO Asia-Taiwan exhibition to demonstrate the professional rigor behind her health/beauty brand, 'Xinyan'. It aims to build consumer trust by showing the scientific and manufacturing processes involved while maintaining an energetic and relatable social media persona.
